critical_experiments.title: factorbase exact interface discrimination
critical_experiments.uncertainty: Empty bases/zero new rank are measured results, not infrastructure failures; inconsistent same-base certificates are invalid and cannot justify any scientific conclusion.
critical_experiments.positive_decision: Archive observation and commission independent integrity/math-joint review; expand only if required verifier passes.
critical_experiments.negative_decision: Preserve exact adverse/zero-yield result and rerank the scoped representation/solver interface; no universal rejection.
critical_experiments.next_action: Complete code/protocol readiness then publish approval; future run by canonical supervisor only.

ambiguity_resolutions.question: How to handle missing subgroup,zero yield or cap?
ambiguity_resolutions.resolution: Retain inadmissible/zero-yield/derived instrument-stop as separate outcomes; never substitute fixture or infer mathematical failure from tooling.
ambiguity_resolutions.basis: Prospective protocol and AGENTS immutable experiment rules.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: Canonical immutable run with actual exact certificate and complete control coverage, followed by independent review on the named joint.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: Keep scoped instrument limit or unknown yield, repair only through a new frozen revision/admission; do not widen search automatically.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Canonical lex/seed schedule and explicit inadmissible cells; no adaptive replacement.
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: Each completed or failed critical observation before another scientific admission.
peripheral_exclusions: New curves/parameter enlargement beyond frozen set
Free oracle recovery counted as candidate success

resource_estimate.stop_rule: Fixed prospective fixtures and exact derived matrix/bit caps; retain all invalid,zero-yield and instrument-stop cells.
